source.name: Destiny Data Compendium, Solar (Ignition); own measurement 2026-10-20; Aegis
source.quote: incur a 1.6 second cooldown before Scorch can be reapplied
source.note: 1.6 s contradicts the measurements: Aegis, Quantum and the in-game test with One Thousand Voices allow at most about 1.3 s. Aegis' Daybreak with Dawn Chorus (every projectile ignites, 588 ms apart) needs more than 1.18 s: 16 234 with 1.3 s against 16 701 measured, 19 609 with 0.95 s. 1.3 s is the value closest to the Compendium within that range (ADR 0011, rule 3).
